name: Better Planet Generation
summary: A huge planet generation overhaul that aims at making your hundreds of hours of exploration in the magnificent, infinite universe of No Man's Sky less repetitive and hopefully even more memorable.
author: WoodyMontana
description:
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][i][b]                                                     [size=6]Better Planet Generation[/size][/b][/i][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629738968-1312445652.jpeg[/img]

[size=4][b]More planets

[/b][size=3]Better Planet Generation is a total overhaul of the planetary generation in No Man's Sky.[/size] [size=3]It improves by a significant margin the procedural aspect of the universe while at the same time respecting the original work and vision from Hello Games.[/size]

[size=3]It adds thousands of new distinct environments to the universe[/size][/size]. All of them come in five different life levels and varying placement scales and layouts. These environments were made to seamlessly combine with each other in many different ways.

Better Planet Generation is designed to bring variety to the different biomes you will visit but most of all it brings a lot of variation to the universe. Outside of the countless combinations of assets and their resulting new environments, planets you visit will present themselves differently each time. Placement layouts, scale of the regions, density, variety of assets and their respective scale, ...

No planet will look exactly the same. Unless, of course, it is a very simple one. More on that below.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1631005159-472402214.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936034-1789086190.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1610300150-1298994048.jpeg[/img]


[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=4][b]Sub Biomes[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Caves and underwater sub biomes have also been entirely overhauled.

Tons of new variants have been added underground and just like on the surface, additional objects can spawn to increase variety even more.

﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410276-924973523.jpeg[/img]﻿

Underwater has been completely revamped and is now generated through a triple layered dynamic framework combining assets to generate highly varied and detailed environments.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629738939-165524032.jpeg[/img]
[b][size=4]
Unique planets

[/size][/b][size=4][size=3]On top of all the added variety, BPG also uses a flexible dynamic generation framework that can take many shapes[/size][/size] and create countless planetary variations, even when the same environments are being used multiple times.

Each planet generated has its own selection of parts based on its biome. Some liberties have been taken when designing and attributing those parts to the various biomes. Some objects have been injected to improve variety, but some restrictions have also been applied to preserve each biome's identity. Better Planet Generation also introduces countless restored, modified or repurposed assets to the game in order to increase the variety while preserving its visual style.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936068-132859967.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630936034-754906087.jpeg[/img]

[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]Natural Generation[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Better Planet Generation is a vastly different experience compared to the unmodded game and even other biome mods.
Not even taking into account the small details, it is more than likely that you will never be able to encounter all the possible assets combinations this mod can generate. Let alone in the different regional layouts each dynamic template can result in.

Each biome has access to multiple procedural templates. Each producing different results in terms of layouts and objects combinations.
Their common goal is to show you a different kind of environment each time. Aesthetically and structurally.
No more "postcard" planets where most of what there is to see is right around the corner. The scale of the generation can get extremely vast compared to the vanilla game.

Planetary generation can now affect your visual enjoyment and the gameplay.
It is a video game, after all.

A world generated at its fullest possible level and highest complexity can take you some time to fully explore on foot. Meaning seeing the most notable regions (and not all of them) and scanning everything.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630052272-1155900954.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1610300150-2086924238.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630272224-118529207.jpeg[/img]
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]More Variation[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

On the other hand, Better Planet Generation also allows more simple, generic yet still visually interesting planets to see :

- Planets only covered in grass and some plants, rocks or both.
- More barren worlds dominated by giant stone or crystal spires.
- Radioactive wastelands.
- Planets dotted with trees or occasional small forests.
- Volcanic wastelands.
- Toxic fields.
- Rocky swamps.
- ...

And the list goes on and on.
[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3]The occurence of these "generic" planets only relies on probabilites. None of my templates is designed to specifically produce them.
I made sure they still looked good, though.[/size][/size][/size][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410296-1590906166.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1626079315-1486130072.jpeg[/img]

[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=4]Different Experience[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Better Planet Generation is not for everyone. Planets can be both very detailed in every aspect or very simple.
If you expect to always see trees and a full grass coverage on your Lush planet or anywhere else, there are other mods for that.
This is not what you should expect using BPG.

Now, whether you are a new player ready to explore an infinite universe or a more weathered one that wants to be surprised by the game again, I suggest you give Better Planet Generation a try. It won't harm your game in any way.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1629923717-282604290.jpeg[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1634/images/797/797-1630410307-2137550589.jpeg[/img]

[size=5][size=3][size=4][size=3][b][size=5]WARNING BEFORE INSTALLING :[/size][/b]

Installing this mod will operate changes to the terrain in every biomes.
It is also recommended to install it while in a space station / anomaly / freighter and not on a planet's surface.
Some major updates to the mod can reset the terrain or biome lists.
I'll include a warning on the download page and the sticky when it's the case.[/size][/size][/size][/size]


Recommended :
[/size][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/968]DUD's Sky - Colors[/url] : load planetary colour palettes before BPG to avoid procedural textures conflicts.
[/size][/size]

name: Increased Lush World Color Diversity
summary: Mod increases the color palette for LUSH biomes in NEXT. 16 colors for grass/plants/leaves. 64 possible primary + secondary grass colors combinations. Mod attempts to sustain the NEXT color tone.
author: ElComostada BuildTest
description: Mod increases the color palette for LUSH biomes in NEXT. Currently NEXT utilizes 4 color types. This mod has increased this number to 16 while retaining NEXT blue and green RGB. Therefore, the mod incorporates 14 new colors which adhere to the new darker realistic tone of NEXT. In addition to the 16 color types there are now 64 possible alt.grass types (Secondary Grass). This essentially means the player will see the same 16 colors but each color now has 4 possible corresponding secondary grass colors, which work with the original color either through stylistic choice or a lighter tone of the original color while adhering to the new NEXT darker style. Lastly, the new 16 color type pool is also enabled for plants and leaves. All other aspects are left untouched. This is to avoid candy colors.

name: Fast Actions 7.1
summary: Faster clicks and key pressed actions
author: Lo2k
description:
Instead of pressing a key for almost one second, this mod provides quicker or instant inputs for :
- menu selection
- creating/dismantling technology
- transfering resources to/from ship
- entering ship
- discussing with NPC
- gathering small plants
- launching refinery processing
- recovering deployable technologies

Enjoy !
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/28/?]
[/url]This mod exists in 2 versions :
﻿- instant actions : almost no delay actions (Fractal 4.13 added an in-game option but it only works for a limited range of actions)
- fast actions : between original and instant actions

[color=#ffd966]New : v7.1 fixes precise item quantity amount selection with Instant Actions. (Fast Action is untouched)[/color]

name: Blue Portal Tunnels
summary: Ever notice how the warp tunnel when you go into a portal is pink, and yet, the portal is blue? This mod fixes that.
author: EthanRDoesMC
description:
With the release of the Atlas Rises update, Hello Games added functionality to portals, along with one of the strangest color choices (at least, in my opinion).

They made the tunnel for warping through a portal... pink. 

And yet, the portal is blue.

THAT MAKES NO SENSE.

[youtube]-3QaR2BtsIg[/youtube]

This is my first mod ever, so I tried to make it in such a way that it's nearly impossible for it to interfere with other mods. So this mod is basically a texture swap.

Hey, there's nothing wrong with that.

Anyway, it modifies TEXTURES/EFFECTS/WARP/WARPLARGEPORTAL.DDS alone, which should not only make it compatible with almost every mod, but also it should, in theory, be compatible with every version of the game - just, pre-1.3 versions won't make use of it.

Put it in (No Man's Sky install dir)/GAMEDATA/PCBANKS/MODS (you might have to make it yourself), then, if you haven't already, rename DISABLEMODS.txt to ENABLEMODS.txt (or delete it, it's up to you).

name: ISAAC Voice Pack
summary: A new exosuit voice in the style of Marvel's J.A.R.V.I.S.
author: RD
description:
[size=3][size=3][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Some people wanted a J.A.R.V.I.S. voice. Unfortunately Paul Bettany wasn't available, so Jay33721 was kind enough to donate his time and voice. [size=3]Thank you![/size]
He's famous in the Skyrim community for voicing Rumarin, Dagri'lon, Relic, [url=https://tes-mods.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Characters_voiced_by_Jay33721]among others[/url]. Listen to an interview with him [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_WBb_PbkjU]here[/url].

The "suit" effect is a bit subtle this time. I was trying to make it sound clear. Maybe I'll add some versions with different effects.

[u][b]Some technical bla bla[/b][/u]
Curious to know how it was done? If not, then just press the download button.

Still here? O.k. then. I used Adobe Audition + the following plugins/settings:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Waves Soundshifter stereo: Lower pitch with -1 semitone.[/size]
[*][size=3]Waves Doubler4 Stereo: Widen sound stage.[/size]
[*][size=3]FFT filter: Raise highs 2000-10000 Hz. Clearer sound.[/size]
[*][size=3]Single-band Compressor: squash down peaks in files. More room for increasing volume without clipping.[/size]
[*][size=3]Hard limiter: Set to -0,2 dB. Making sure audio doesn't exceed 0 dB (=distortion). [/size]
[*][size=3]Match loudness: Volume check, files are -7 to -8  (Same as vanilla).[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[url=https://i.ibb.co/sqBSYyB/2019-10-04-00-29-21-Adobe-Audition-CC-2017-big.jpg][img]https://i.ibb.co/8g5Rbtg/2019-10-04-00-29-21-Adobe-Audition-CC-2017-small.jpg[/img][/url]
"Can it go louder?" No, the files reach 0 dB!!
"But vanilla voice sounds louder": The high pitch voice is [i]perceived[/i] louder. NMS has a somewhat annoying audio system. I also had a deep voice mod like Crysis, but it just doesn't work.

That's all folks. Now go download and have fun. If you approve, please endorse.

[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]204 new voice files.[/size]
[*][size=3]U.K. Accent.[/size]
[*][size=3]Localized support.[/size]
[/list][size=3][u][b]
Files affected[/b][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2][size=2]NMSARC.5B11B94C - AUDIO\WINDOWS\ENGLISH(US)\[all files][/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]NMSARC.761ACED1 - [size=2][size=2]AUDIO\WINDOWS\ENGLISH(US)\[/size][/size]VOCAL_LOCALISED.BNK[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3][u][b]
Installation[/b][/u]
1) Create the folder MODS in \GAMEDATA\PCBANKS of No Man's Sky.
2) Unzip and copy .pak file to the MODS folder.
3) Rename [color=#a4c2f4][b]DISABLEMODS.TXT[/b][/color] to [color=#a4c2f4][b]zzzDISABLEMODS.TXT[/b][/color].
4) Start the game.[/size][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/206]
[/url]

name: Better Rewards
summary: Increase the amount of currency you get with faster word learning and increased resource gathering options. Frigate (Freighter) Expeditions are also included!
author: MrTrack
description:
Better Rewards increases the amount of units, nanite clusters and quicksilver you get from completing missions or interacting with objects in the world. Non npc word learning (such as knowledge stones and dictionaries) is also faster.

[color=#bf9000][size=3]IMPORTANT NOTE: Don't use this mod when I haven't updated it to the new game version (especially when it is a new or returning expedition)
[/size][/color][color=#bf9000]if you really want to use it when I haven't updated it yet, make sure you [/color][color=#bf9000]back up your save[/color][color=#bf9000] or build the mod using the lua scripts yourself.[/color]

[b]Currency[/b]

Currency gain is roughly increased by 5 times, so as to make it a viable option besides crafting and selling valuable trading goods. Some unit values were tremendously increased (eg.: from minimum amount of 1000-2000 to 20000-50000) like the terminals in abandoned settlements to make the early game less grindy.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Space station missions and Nexus missions
[*]Interactable objects/devices (abandoned buildings, damaged machinery, waypoints, etc.)
[*]Sentinels
[*]Alien interactions
[/list]
[b]Words[/b]

Learning words from non npc interactions (knowledge stones and dictionaries) is also 3 times faster (3 words learned form a single knowledge stone). You now also learn 5 Atlas words, instead of 1 and also have a chance (15%) to learn them when interacting with non npc learning sources.

[b]Resources

[/b]When gathering with the mining beam you generally get 2 times more resources (but only when the things explode as you mine them). Also includes containers, depots, guild rewards, asteroids and ships that drop resources.

[b]Frigate (Freighter) Expedition Rewards

[/b]After a successful expedition, when collecting your rewards you get 5x more units and nanites, 2x more products like Storage Augmentation and NipNip Buds and 3x more resources like Copper, Emeril and Cadmium.
[b]
Installation

[/b]Make sure you delete or edit DISABLEMODS.TXT in your game library (...\Steam\steamapps\common\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS) before trying to use mods. Extract the zip file to ...\Steam\steamapps\common\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\MODS folder and you are good to go (Create MODS folder if you don't have one). Alternatively you can just use Vortex to download and install.

This mod modifies the [color=#ff0000][size=3]REWARDTABLE.MBIN[/size][/color] and [color=#ff0000][size=3]EXPEDITIONREWARDTABLE.MBIN[/size][/color] file and will not work with other mods that use those tables.

[b]Updated to NMS version 6.21 (Build ID: 21918502) on 2026.02.13.[/b]

name: Black Space 4.3
summary: Makes space much darker
author: Lo2k
description:
This mod replaces fully colored space by a more common black space.

You can choose between 2 versions :
  - Black Space : Pure black space, white suns, no nebulae
  - Black Space + Nebulae : Black space but colored suns and colored nebulae

Since 2.2B, you can now also remove the too numerous stars from the sky with the No Stars optional mod (there's sadly no available slider yet in the game to just reduce the amount of stars visible in the sky).


Enjoy.

Optional : 
- Enjoy black space even more with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1084][color=#ffd966]No Space Dust and No Space Plasma[/color][/url]
- Enjoy black space without bloom everywhere with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2315][color=#ffd966]No Bloom Effect[/color]
[/url]- Enjoy Station and other indoor place independent of (black) space color with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2440][color=#ffd966]Indoors Lighting Fix[/color][/url]

[color=#ffd966]
News in v4.3 : No Star was updated for 6.45 game version. Both Black Space mods are still fine as 3.0.[/color]

[size=2]Compatibility : [/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/880][color=#ffd966]- [u]CHECK IF THIS MOD IS COMPATIBLE WITH LATEST GAME VERSION[/u][/color][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/articles/85][color=#f6b26b]- [u]CHECK IF THIS MOD NEEDS TO BE MERGED WITH ANOTHER OF MY MODS[/u][/color][/url]
These mods edit the following files :
    - METADATA\SIMULATION\SOLARSYSTEM\WEATHER\SKYSETTINGS\SPACESKYCOLOURS.MBIN
    - METADATA\SIMULATION\SOLARSYSTEM\WEATHER\SKYSETTINGS\SPACERARESKYCOLOURS.MBIN


Credits : Thanks to Rayrod who pointed me toward the right files now that shaders can't be edited anymore.

name: NomNom
summary: NomNom is the most complete savegame editor for NMS but also shows you additional information around the data you're about to change. You can also easily look up each item individually to examine its attributes, independently of a savegame, or get other useful information that are not related to a specific one (but enhanced if one is loaded).
author: zencq
description:
[color=#e69138][size=3][b]NomNom is now in beta state.[/b] This means for you that some things may still not be 100% finished but the general state of the tool is a lot better than before.[/size] If you encounter bugs or when you think something doesn't work as expected or could be improved, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1566?tab=bugs]let me know[/url]![/color]

[color=#ff0000]All available features are tested while implemented but mistakes can happen, so be aware of that and backup your saves![/color]

The features can be divided into the different main parts:
[list]
[*][b]Manager[/b] Manage your saves!
[list]
[*]Automatic backup.[/*]
[*]Save your save as human-readable JSON.[/*]
[*]Copy, move, and swap slots to another.[/*]
[*]Delete your save.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Editor[/b] Edit your save for your needs!
[list]
[*]Ability to manage fleets, change data values like currencies and stats, and organize inventories.[/*]
[*]Ability to fast travel to any system you like, trigger space battles, and clear portal interference.[/*]
[*]Ability to edit your knowledge and recorded experiences.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
Have a look at the screenshots as well, to see what NomNom is capable of.

Each version of NomNom is built with the latest game version (at that time) in mind and the version number is reflecting that. Each one is also backwards
compatible down to [b]Beyond 2.11[/b] and even saves before that can still be edited via the build-in JSON editor. If you use it with a newer game version branch than
the one it was built for (e.g. [b]7.00[/b]), things should work as usual in most cases but there can always be a breaking change.

NomNom is compatible with every platform No Man's Sky is available on (some work better than others though). You can select a specific account/folder with you saves or, for platforms on PC, one level above if you have multiple accounts. A complete and always up-to-date overview with additional notes can be found [url=https://github.com/zencq/libNOM.io?tab=readme-ov-file#getting-started]on GitHub[/url].


[b]Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]After downloading and extracting the zip file you'll find a few files. All you need to care about is the executable ([b]NomNom.exe[/b]) but new folders may    be created at runtime (e.g. for backups) that will become relevant to you.[/*]
[*]You may want to create a shortcut to the executable for easier access.[/*]
[*]As the tool includes an automatic backup functionality you don't need to do it manually but if you want to be absolutely safe, do it.[/*]
[*]At first start the tool locates your saves at the default location of each platform but if that fails, you must select it manually.[/*]
[*]Select a slot.[/*]
[*]Start tinkering![/*]
[/list]

If you like NomNom and want to support me in its further development, you can do so via the donation options above or on [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/cengelha]Buy Me a Coffee[/url], [url=https://github.com/sponsors/cengelha]GitHub[/url], [url=https://ko-fi.com/cengelha]Ko-fi[/url], and [url=https://www.patreon.com/cengelha]Patreon[/url]. I will appreciate it!
There won't be a paywall though.

The is also a dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/nomnom-762409407488720918]Discord[/url] server where you'll find all information in one place, firsthand. Please read the rules first, to gain full access. If you need (or want to offer) help, found a bug, have a suggestion, or something else regarding NomNom, you will find, or can post it there.

Issues created here on Nexus Mods or via another channel will of course also be addressed.


Header image by [url=https://patreon.com/Orioto]Orioto[/url]﻿.

name: ViperClaw's Rosetta Stone - Learn more words (for Desolation v2.62) (Now with multiple versions)
summary: Learn multiple new words each time.  MULTILANGUAGE NOW AVAILABLE!
author: ViperClaw
description:
[center][size=4]Mod Intro[/size][/center]
Are you tired of not understanding everyone around you?
Accidentally deleted a Korvax's research because you didn't know the word for save and pressed the wrong button?
Did you give away all your life savings to that shady Gek Prince because you couldn't read and understand the contract you were signing?
Have you started a fight with a Vy'keen after accidentally insulting their family when you were trying to ask for directions?

Did you wish you could be fluent in all their languages much more quickly and easilly?

Well then look no further, the answer to all your problems is here!

With ViperClaw's Rosetta Stone you will soon be in with the cool kids by learning multiple words every time!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[center][size=4]Description / Information[/size][/center]
[color=#ff0000]STILL WORKS ON LATEST PATCH VERSION 2.62[/color]

With this mod you will learn multiple words every time depending on the version.
The newest version learns words of all languages including Atlas when using knowledge stones instead of just the one and is now compatible with plaques and ruins however those will only teach the main language of the galaxy you are in.

Currently the multilanguage version will teach 2, 3 or 5 of EACH language from the Knowledge Stones meaning you get a total of 6, 12 or 20 words from each stone across all the languages.

I've updated the previously "OLD" version to work with plaques and ruins but they still only teach the language of the galaxy.


Note that the event notification popups has a limit of 10 popups in a row so the game won't display all the words learnt on the popups but you will still receive them and this can be checked on the milestones.




[color=#ff0000][b][color=#ff7700]IMPORTANT NOTE - This mod DOES NOT WORK WITH NPC's as they require word categories to be specified so I decided against including the NPC's as it would require a large amount of editing so the Knowledge Stones and Ruins are much more efficient.

As already mentioned the event notifications has a limit of 10 events in a row and will not display words learnt past the 10th word but you will still learn these and it can be confirmed by checking your milestones.

[/color][/b][/color]

Don't forget to endorse :)



TO DO / UPCOMING:
[s]- Ruins for atlas words[/s] - Done
[s]- Monolith / Plaques (might not be possible)[/s] - Done


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version History -
V1.3b - Updated / added single language version as optional to work with plaques and ruins. No other changes made as still works for latest version
V1.3 - Multi Language learning and plaques / ruins included
V1.2 - Other versions with different number of words created
V1.1 - Updated for 2.61 (wasn't even finished uploading the mod and the update dropped on steam....)
V1.0 - Created for Desolation 2.6


Compatibility : 
- This mod can't be used along any other mod modifying METADATA\REALITY\TABLES\REWARDTABLE.MBIN

name: Learn More Words (Echoes Patch)
summary: A mod that increases the number of words learned from Knowledge Stones and Encyclopedias by a certain number.
author: TheJollyDuck
description:
[size=4]Description:[/size]
This mod increases the number of words learnt by Knowledge Stones and Encyclopedias (inside those cabin things) to a certain number. I made this to speed up the learning process but still have to grind to find stones. This does not affect Monoliths and talking to people, asking them for knowledge as I don't know how to change that. But this should suffice your yearning to understand others. I'd like to thank the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1139]this mod[/url] as it helped with figuring this stuff out (referenced their de-compiled .pak file).

Due to particular demand from users, there are different kinds of versions of the mod, depending on how easier you'd like your playthrough to be.

[size=3]Learn More Words (3/5/10/20 Words):[/size]
This is the standard type, with 10 being the default for Vortex.

[size=3]Learn More Words Multiple Faction Languages (5/10/20/Complete Words):[/size]
With this version, when interacting with knowledge stones, you get N amount of words per language. Complete is a once-only version, meaning that you only need to activate a stone once.

NMS has changed their language system so that derived words are also learnt, meaning that more than what was specified in the mod can be learnt. For example, learning "trade" will also make you learn "trader", "trading", etc. It is also harder now to determine words learnt since they removed the counter in-game for it AFAIK.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
Installing mods can be done by navigating to "~\Steam\steamapps\common\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS".
Delete or rename the "DISABLEMODS.txt" to something else and create a folder "MODS". You can then place the .pak file in that folder, and you're set!

[size=4]Updating:
[/size]I have created a .lua file that is available in the files tab which you can use in AMUMSS to generate the .pak file for merging with other mods, if you prefer a different amount of words learnt, or if you want to extend functionality to the mod.
[size=4]
Compatibility:[/size]
Compatibility only has problems if they use the "REWARDTABLE.MBIN" file. Unless you want to merge the mods together.

name: Faster Movement Speed 3.0
summary: Increases walk and run speed
author: AsxACE
description:
This mod was [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1520][color=#f1c232]originaly designed by ASxACE[/color][/url] to make walk and run speed less sluggish than the vanilla speed.

In details, speed are multiplied by the following factors to make them more pleasing :
- Walk speed x1.6
- Run Speed x1.5
- 0G Speed x2.0

I quickly adopted it myself in my play sessions and as ASxACE didn't update it, I continued to update it for my personal use.
Finaly, after Prisms update, I asked him if he will update it or if I could do it otherwise and he agreed.
So here is this fine mod up again.
Enjoy

Optional :
- Makes slidings more effective with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2362][color=#ffd966]Slippery Slopes
[/color][/url]

[b]This mod has been updated for World Parts 2[/b]

name: Fast Refiners
summary: Refiners & Food Processors 10 times faster. Added an "Instant Refiners" variation for all you cheaters out there ! Compatible with NMS "THE SWARM" v.6.44 (Steam's build 23583900).
author: wim95 - NooBzPoWaH - Backing vocals by Babscoole
description:
[center][b]Description[/b] :

This Mod makes Refiners Speed 10 times Faster or Instantly !
(Personal, Portable, Medium & Large ones)
Same goes for Food Processor !


**********************************************************************************************************************

[b]Installation Instructions[/b] :

[b]Manually[/b] :

Place the "[b]Fast Refiners[/b]" [b][color=#00ffff]or[/color][/b] the "[b]Instant Refiners[/b]" folder (inside the zip file) in your
[b][color=#00ffff]InstallPath\No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\MODS folder[/color][/b].

[b][color=#ff0000]Beware NOT in No Man's Sky\GAMEDATA\PCBANKS\MODS folder anymore !!![/color][/b]

or

[b]Via Vortex[/b] (Nexus new Mod Manager) :

Just click on the "[b]Mod Manager Download[/b]" button.


**********************************************************************************************************************

[b]Compatibility[/b] : 

[color=#00ffff]Compatible with [b]NMS[/b] "[url=https://www.nomanssky.com/swarm-update/]THE SWARM[/url]" v.[url=https://www.nomanssky.com/release-log/]6.44
[/url]( Steam's Build [url=https://steamdb.info/app/275850/depots/]23583900[/url] )[/color]

[b][u][color=#ff0000][size=4]3xperimental branch is not supported ![/size][/color][/u][/b]


[b]Modified File[/b] :

[color=#00ffff]METADATA\REALITY\TABLES\[b]NMS_REALITY_GCRECIPETABLE.MBIN

[/b][/color][size=2][b][color=#ff00ff]Thanks[/color][/b] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/1940575]BladehawkeX[/url] it is now provided as a patch/snippet (EXML).[/size]


**********************************************************************************************************************

[b]Merging/Updating Process[/b] :

An .lua file is provided as well to be merged via "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/957/]AMUMSS[/url]" with any other Mod
providing some lua file(s) and modifying '[b]NMS_REALITY_GCRECIPETABLE.MBIN[/b]'.

To merge Mods with the latest release of "[url=https://github.com/HolterPhylo/AMUMSS/releases/]AMUMSS[/url]" (v5.4.1.1W+) it's real easy !

First of all install/update your [url=https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet].NET[/url] to (at least) the latest 6.0 Desktop :
[url=https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/thank-you/runtime-desktop-6.0.36-windows-x64-installer]https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/6.0[/url]
(at the time i'm writing this it's ".NET Desktop Runtime 6.0.36")
As long as you're at it install/update .NET [url=https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/8.0]8.0[/url], [url=https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/9.0]9.0[/url] & [url=https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0]10.0[/url].

You would have to choose an .lua file from the Mod you'd want to merge and the one from our Mod,
put them both in the "ModScript" "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/957/]AMUMSS[/url]" folder, run "BUILDMOD.bat",
answer whatever you want to the questions asked,
let it do its thing and get the folder (that can be renamed to whatever)
from the "CreatedMODS" folder,
if you choose not to put it straight into your MODS folder,
then put it there and delete both of our old folders.

For more details or updated ones check out "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2626]How to use AMUMSS[/url]".

[b]That merge needs to be done again every time a Mod is updating ![/b]

Updating the Mod (in case i'm not around to do so)
is the same process as above with only our .lua file instead of two or more.


**********************************************************************************************************************

[b]Uninstallation[/b] :

Such a sad and awful thing to do...

Delete the "[b]Fast Refiners[/b]" or "[b]Instant Refiners[/b]" folder from your
MODS folder, or Disable/Uninstall and Remove it via Vortex.

That's it. Bye Bye ! ;)


**********************************************************************************************************************

[b]Disclaimer[/b] :

Since Nexus last move (Collections and deletion policy) wim95 has lost trust/faith in Nexus,
and i for sure can't blame him for it.
As a result he took all his Mods down and gave me permission to updload a new "Fast Refiners" Mod.

[b][color=#ffd966]So Big Shout Out and Many Thanks to him for it in the name of the community ![/color][/b][/center]

name: Steven Hawking Suit Voice Replacer (Frontiers Compatible)
summary: Replaces suit voice with that of Steven Hawking
author: SoulNMS - JigglyJego
description:
There was a suit voice mod which replaced the Exo-suit voice with Steven Hawking's voice, but it only worked in earlier versions, this one works in the current versions. (CREDIT TO JIGGLYJEGO FOR THE ORIGINAL MOD)
[youtube]l0Hi7pKatPI[/youtube]
How to add mods-> Navigate to No Man's Sky game folder -> GAMEDATA -> PCBANKS -> DELETE DISABLEMODS.TXT -> New folder -> "Mods" -> Add mod as a .pak file

name: Sailship Re-alignments

author: lMonk
description:
[size=3][color=#BF9000][size=5][b]Sailship Re-a[/b][/size][/color][/size][color=#BF9000][size=5][b]lignments 1.92[/b][/size][/color][size=3]

[color=#BF9000][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
A collection of fixes for the sailship:
- Re-align engine trails for body_A (Raven) and wings D (talon) & E (grapple).
- Re-align all guns to point forward instead of aligned with the body.
- Decal placement tweaks (noticeable mainly when using my logo decals mod).
- Restore procedural sail lights to match the sail's color.
- Restore broken flap-covered blue bulb lights
- body_F (grouper) engine spike texture and placement fixed.
- body_A (Raven) engine spike and flame placement fixed.
[color=#ffff00]- Restore procedural sail lights color [b]is included [/b][b][size=3][color=#ffff00]in this mod[i].[/i][/color][/size][/b][/color]

⚠️ Overwrite mod - unlikely to work well with other Overwrite mods[color=#BF9000][size=4][b]

Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Unzip the mod and place the full folder into [color=#f4cccc]{NMS Install Folder}\GAMEDATA\MODS[/color] (not PCBANKS). Create MODS folder if necessary.
[size=3]If the mod(s) still doesn't work, delete the mod settings file [color=#f4cccc]{NMS Install Folder}\Binaries\SETTINGS\GCMODSETTINGS.MXML[/color] and try again.[/size][/size]

name: Fewer Fauna
summary: Greatly decreases the presence of planetary fauna throughout the galaxy.
author: courtykat
description:
[size=1]Contrary to my other mod, Moar Creatures, this mod was made by request to reduce the amount of fauna on each planet. This mod is handy if you dislike seeing the same creatures on repeat or if you want planetary life to be a more special find. In version 1.0 you'll see an average of 0-2 species per planet, a 90-95% decrease from vanilla. There are 2 files:[/size]

[size=3][b]Fewer Species - [/b]Reduces the number of creatures per planet by 90-95%
[b]Fewer Fauna Spawns - [/b]Reduces creatures' spawn frequency by 90%[/size]

[b]**Both of these files can be used either together or stand-alone.[/b]


[center]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]


[b][size=3]RECOMMENDED - My Other Creature Mods:[/size][/b]
[b] [/b][size=2][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2395]More Cave Spawns[/url]﻿ - [/b]raises the frequency of cave spawns for easier fauna scans
[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2373]Moar Creatures[/url]﻿ -[/b] increases the herd size of planetary fauna

[size=4]Combining with Fewer Species:[/size][size=2][color=#f4f4f4]
﻿[b]More Cave Spawns[/b][/color][b]  -[/b]  [color=#00ff00]Compatible[/color]
[b] ﻿No Cave Spawns [/b][b] -[/b]  [color=#ff0000]Incompatible[/color]
﻿[b]Moar Creatures  -  [/b][color=#ff0000]Incompatible[/color][color=#00ff00]

[/color][/size][/size][size=4]Combining with Fewer Fauna Spawns:[/size][size=2][color=#f4f4f4]

name: hF's Freighter Retexture (WORLDS)
summary: Freighter Retexture for Venator, Sentinel, Normal & Tiny Freighters. 5 versions: Normal, Shine, Matte, Squared & Metallic. Be sure to check the optional section for extras.
author: hemis FEAR
description:
[size=3][b]> Update v1.6 is now available <
[/b]
This update brings this mod to the current version only -- no changes were made. I am working on covering the pirate dreadnaught, and that will be released in a future updated. Soon.

So, it goes without saying, the current version does [i]not [/i]include pirate freighters.

[b]NOTE: [/b]For those who use [b]fSails - [/b]I've posted a [b]LOD [/b]fix in the optional DL's section. This allows you to see all of your [b]Sails[/b] on large [b]Capital Freighters[/b] clearly - even ones far away.
[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Version info[/size][/u] [/b][size=3](there are 5 versions of this mod)[/size][b]:[/b]

[size=3][b]Normal [/b]is the original, what I built upon and will continue to do so going forward. It is in the middle as far as glossiness. 

[b]Super Metal (SMetal) [/b]is [i]fully [/i]metallic and glossy. 

[list]
[*][size=3]For [b]gold, [/b]select [b]yellow, orange, [/b]or [b]red [/b](red is only available with certain Capital Freighters) [/size]
[*][size=3]For [b]chrome, [/b]select [b]white [/b]or [b]gray [/b][/size]
[/list]
Note: [i]some[/i] Freighters will be more of a titanium instead of chrome when selecting white, & these Freighters will also be the ones that color gold & brown instead of red & dark red. These are less common, but still keep that in mind. The current version can be pretty dark in some systems. New version will be more visible.

Model seed for Freighter in picture: 0x888576E7F3A805EB (chrome) - see below for guide on how to use a save editor
[b]
Super Shine (SS) [/b]is almost as glossy as you could possibly get within the game. Note that, in some systems, it can be [i]very [/i]shiny. - almost mirror-esque (see photos). Also, with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/968]Dud's Sky - Colors[/url], gloss is very much intensified. If you are running stock or close to, or have no mods that impact how space [i]looks, [/i]you'll find it to be a lot less intense than in the photos. Basically, if there's nothing around to reflect, it won't. 

[b]Full Matte (FM)[/b] There may be [i]some [/i]shine depending on the system, but for the most part, it is completely matte. Also, only areas that are painted are actually matte. If it changes color when you switch colors, then it's painted. 

[b]Squared[/b] version's textures are slightly raised and defined around all four sides - hence why I named it "squared." Looks cool and provides a different look from the other versions, which are more streamlined and smoother. It has the same shine / gloss level as the normal version of this mod.

[b]Fully compatible with latest version 5.28 (WORLDS) including add-ons)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[/b][/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/7YShvp1.jpg[/img]
[size=4][b]

^Golden Freighter pictured^
[/b][/size][size=3]
[b]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]
For a list of different Freighter seeds (including native-metallic), visit my Github page: [url=https://github.com/hemisFEAR/NMS-Modding/blob/main/Seeds/Freighter%20Retexture%20Seeds.txt]Freighter Retexture Seeds[/url]

If you don't know how to change seeds with a Save Editor, I've included a short guide in that list to hopefully help get you started. And If that's not enough,  here's a comprehensive video tutorial on how to use NMS Save Editor - courtesy of Elite Gamers: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqYFgjHo4y0&ab_channel=EliteGamer]How To Use NMS Save Editor[/url]
[b]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/b]
1. Navigate to Content> GAMEDATA> PCBANKS folder (inside of your NMS installation folder)
2. Rename DISABLEMODS file to ENABLEMODS if not already present.
4. Copy "_hF_FreighterRetexture_PICKVERSION_1.5.pak" into that MODS folder

[b]This MOD modifies (aside from the textures themselves):
[/b]
- FREIGHTER_PROC.TEXTURE.MBIN
- SMALL_STRIPES.TEXTURE.MBIN
- STRIPE_SINGLE.TEXTURE.MBIN
- Numerous FREIGHTERPROC_MAT files
- Numerous WINDOWLIGHT_MAT files 
- Numerous DECAL.MATERIAL files 
- Numerous MATERIAL files 

[b]*NOTE: This mod conflicts with the Metallic Materials Fix mod*[/b]

[b]TEXTURES folders for use with AMUMSS are now found in the [i]Optional Files [/i]section - [/b]to save space as there are now five versions.

[u]*THANK YOU to both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/users/5044289]NooBzPoWaH[/url] & Lowkie for their help early on in mod development!!*
[/u]
Other mods that I recommend using with this mod:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2675]Redmas' Utopia Revamp (Space Colors Module - Intensifies gloss the most)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/968]DUD'S Sky - Colors (Intensifies gloss)
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2754]gLight Better Ship Lighting[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1324?tab=files]Clean Paint for Starships
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2666]Less NPC's on Freighter Base
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/944]JJ's Bridge﻿
[/url]OR
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/2050]Astro's Bridge[/url][/size]

Improves the lighting on landing pads in freighters, space stations, Nexus Anomaly, and bases by making lighting pure white, increasing brightness, and adding an overhead light where needed. Now split into 6 files so you can mix and match.
author: Gumsk
description:
[size=2]⚠️ Replacement mod - unlikely to work well with other Replacement mods[/size]



[size=4]Get true colors and better lighting for ships on landing pads. Improves the lighting on landing pads in the freighter, space stations, Nexus Anomaly, and bases by making lighting pure white, increasing brightness, and adding an overhead light where needed. Now split between 6 files so you can mix and match. This mod is for the landing pads in newer space stations. An optional file is included for the space station ambience lights; this decreases variety in the game but makes space station landing pads a tiny bit more accurate (I don't really recommend it).[/size]


[size=2]
Use Vortex or manually put the entire contents of the zip file in your GAMEDATA\MODS folder, [i]not [/i]PCBANKS, similar to this:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZRHHnjJK/image.png[/img]

You can find information about and links to all my mods, files affected by each of my mods, instructions for installing mods, and instructions for extracting LUA files here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1541/]https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/1541/[/url][/size]

name: Jelly Boss Enhanced
summary: Makes Boss of Expedition 16 more powerful. Come and get friends together to play this raid now!
author: ZNECrode
description:
HG designed a boss at the end of Expedition 16: The Cursed. However, the boss is to weak that we can just a few shoots to defeat it.
[size=4][b]Now it backs, with more power![/b][/size]

[size=3][b]This mod has 3 versions of the boss:[/b][/size] Easy version [size=3][b]131K[/b][/size] Health, Normal version [size=4][b]8M[/b][/size] Health and the Challenge version [size=5][b]134M[/b][/size] Health!
[size=3][b]Also, different version, different attack ways.[/b][/size]
In easy version, the boss will behave as it in Expd 16, it will keep broods' amount to max then attack player.
But in next 2 versions, the boss may attack player any time without caring about its broods.
[size=3][b]Warning:[/b][/size] [size=3]After internal tests I found that normal and especially challenge version is difficult for solo, please call your friends together to fight with it.[/size]

[b]NOT[/b] everyone needs to install this mod. Only if you want to spawn the boss. Players without this mod can join the fight too.
You need to drink [b]Elixir of Water[/b] to summon the boss. Please be sure in open places otherwise it may be spawned in your base and stuck in walls. : - )
If you do not have [b]Elixir of Water[/b], you can use this mod by AltF4 ->[size=3][b] [/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/nomanssky/mods/3248][size=3][b]Unlockable Elixir Tree
[/b][/size][/url]
Modified File: METADATA\SIMULATION\SCENE\EXPERIENCESPAWNTABLE.MBIN

Hope you enjoy. Have fun with your friends!


HG在远征16：被诅咒者的末尾设计了一个Boss，但是那个玩意几下就能打爆一点意思都没有。
[size=4][b]现在它将带着强大的力量归来！

[/b][/size][size=3][b]这个模组有三个版本：[/b][/size]简单版Boss有[size=3][b]13万[/b][/size]生命值，普通版是[size=4][b]800万[/b][/size]，而挑战版是[size=5][b]1亿3400万[/b][/size]！

name: Buy All Corvette Parts
summary: This mod adds all corvette parts to the basic store for purchase with credits.
author: DerangedTeddy
description:
[b]Compatible Game Version: [/b]6.06 (9/29/2025 Patch)

I don't care much for the bartering system in NMS and wanted to be able to buy parts through the store instead of being forced to barter for them.  This mod adds all corvette parts to the "basic parts" store so that players can purchase them with credits.  I did not adjust any of the part values from their defaults, so these are the vanilla part values.

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: [/b]This mod does not add the parts to the Galactic Trade Terminal.  It is only adding the parts to the corvette parts dealer's "basic parts store."
[b]
Conflicts:[/b] At the time of this writing (9/29/2025) there are no confirmed conflicts.  This mod will conflict with any mod that also modifies the default items in the corvette basic parts store.  It should not conflict with any other mods as it only modifies what is absolutely necessary to achieve this result.  Since it is a change to a storefront, it should not affect your save files, but always back them up just in case as good practice before installing any mod for any game.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Use the Nexus mod installer or manually unzip the folder to your steam/steamapps/common/No Man's Sky/GAMEDATA/MODS/ folder.  If the MODS folder does not exist (usually because you've never installed mods before), you may need to create it manually.

[b]Warranty Disclaimer:[/b]
You are installing this software at your own risk.  It does not come with any warranty, express or implied.  I do not accept any responsibility for any damage this may cause to your game, save files, or computer.

name: Deepest Gas Giant Oceans
summary: Makes gas giants have really deep oceans.
author: kerbal142857
description:
[b][size=5]Slightly Longer Overview[/size][/b]

In real life, gas giants' atmospheres gradually get thicker until it becomes liquid, sort of like making fog denser and denser until it is just water. In the vanilla game, the only liquid present is in small puddles, not even large lakes. This mod changes that, and makes the sea level on gas giants a [i]lot[/i] higher.

How much higher?

Well, you could possibly get to a depth of 1,750u!

Understandably, this makes the "surfaces" of gas giants practically just a gigantic ocean. As such, Aqua-Jets (or a corvette) are basically required to visit gas giants.

[b][size=5]Installation Instructions:[/size]

[/b]1. Download the .zip file
2. Copy the contents of the .zip file to [file directory]/No Man's Sky/GAMEDATA/MODS [[b]NOT(!)[/b] [file directory]/No Man's Sky/GAMEDATA/PCBANKS/MODS] (create such a folder if it does not yet exist)

Upon launching No Man's Sky, you should see a mod warning screen after the first three loading screens.

[size=5][b]IMPORTANT NOTICE:
[/b][/size]
[b]This mod (for some reason) removes portals on gas giants! The terrain generation is significantly changed, so it may make some bases on gas giants inaccessible.[/b]

[line]
[size=5][b]Technical Details[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Files Changed[/b][/size]
[quote][list]
[*]METADATA/REALITY/DEFAULTREALITY.MBIN[/*]
[/list][/quote][size=4][b]Mod Format Explantion[/b][/size]
[quote]
[b]EXML Format:[/b] [u]Partial edit[/u], only touches the lines/values that need editing. Very low chance of conflicts with other mods (unless they edit the same values). Can be edited easily by user using an editor like Notepad ++/VSCODE/... .
[b]MBIN Format:[/b] [u]Full File Replacement[/u]. High chance of conflict, comparable with old pak format (pre. WORLDS). Can be used together with EXML, MBIN mods are loaded first so changes in EXML mods that edit the same file will still be applied.
